## Which side of the wall (see vision.md)
- [ ] Jira facts (the sync, the printed face)
- [ ] The plan (stickies, what's on the wall around cards)

## Checks
- [ ] Printed Jira facts stay read-only and rendered from the sync, in every view
- [ ] Counts say their unit; hidden things are counted and findable
- [ ] Plan format changes say how old copies and merges behave
- [ ] The page still never contacts Jira; tokens stay in the sync script's credential store
- [ ] Made-up names only (`./tools/check-private.sh`)
